scope: Only the 83 previously missing registered heldout units were executed; 205 prior verified receipts were reused read-only. No retraining or simulator dispatch occurred during final analysis.

primary_contrast.interpretation: The interval spans zero; this study does not establish an advantage of the JTRAIN full training procedure over PGONLY, and does not establish equivalence.

limitations: Native surrogate with privileged training state; no live-game or public-transfer claim.
Matching owner seeds do not imply common post-action RNG paths.
The contrast is a full training-procedure difference, not fixed-data causal isolation of the elite-loss term.
Terminal floor 16 does not identify first-Boss cause.

verification.memory_regression: Streaming feature aggregation keeps only one decoded owner payload live.
verification.dispatch_guard: Analysis-only helper rejects all simulator dispatch.
